data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 1145 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1145). Gives the review-bot boot path (opcert_service.workspace._populate) a short bounded ensure-sweep budget: new module constants _ENSURE_BOOT_TIMEOUT=5 / _ENSURE_BOOT_ATTEMPTS=1 passed to run_ensures, mirroring the MCP-boot budget in mcp_server.py, so a contended lock skips (and re-runs next boot) instead of burning write_lock's 60s default behind the 30s HEALTH_TIMEOUT. Did NOT touch _commands/init.py or fsck.py (owned by in-progress bug 01e8); mcp_server.py already had the short budget. New test tests/unit/test_ensures_boot_budget_e43f.py covers all four ACs (bounded budget declared; boot path passes it; held-lock returns promptly + logs skip; skipped sweep re-runs; StoreIncompatibleError still fails closed). Regression guard fails on the pre-fix default. make lint/typecheck clean; boot-budget+opcert+ensures suites (31 tests) green. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
